name: install Homebrew into ~/.homebrew
purpose: Isolated Homebrew -- never /opt/homebrew or /usr/local, no sudo required

name: load Homebrew into this shell
purpose: Puts brew on PATH for every step below (stow, mise, brew bundle)

name: prepare stow target directories
purpose: Forces file-level links so tools write runtime state into $HOME, not the dotfiles repository

name: stow dev profile
purpose: Symlinks individual managed files into $HOME, including ~/.local/bin/sync-external-repos

name: install pinned tools (mise)
purpose: CLI tools and language runtimes are pinned to exact versions in dev/.config/mise/config.toml; Homebrew cannot pin or roll back. Must run after the stow step, which links that file into $HOME where mise reads it

name: install Brewfile packages
purpose: Only what mise cannot pin: bootstrap deps, formulae with no mise backend, the docker CLI plugins, and casks. Runs after mise so a failure here cannot leave the pinned toolchain uninstalled

name: wire docker CLI plugins
purpose: docker resolves buildx/compose from ~/.docker/cli-plugins, not PATH -- installing the formulae is not enough
